description: Frontend for Absen Masuk: add the staffAttendanceAPI client to api.ts, add the two sidebar nav entries in DashboardLayout.tsx, and create three pages — the guru/staff self check-in page (/absen-masuk) with GPS + device_id + 7-day history, the admin rekap page (/admin/absen-masuk) with date/role filters + summary + CSV export, and the admin settings page (/admin/absen-masuk/settings) for school coordinates/radius/check-in window. Depends on FEAT-001 having defined and registered the API endpoints.
steps: Append the staffAttendanceAPI client to src/services/api.ts after the final graduationAPI export, using the shared `api` axios instance. Export: `export const staffAttendanceAPI = { checkIn: (data: { latitude?: number; longitude?: number; device_id?: string; notes?: string }) => api.post('/staff-attendance/check-in', data), todayStatus: () => api.get<{ success: boolean; data: { has_checked_in: boolean; checked_in_at: string | null; location_method: string | null; is_location_valid: boolean } }>('/staff-attendance/today'), myHistory: (params?: { page?: number }) => api.get('/staff-attendance/history', { params }), adminIndex: (params?: { date?: string; role?: string }) => api.get('/staff-attendance', { params }), adminExportCsv: (params?: { date?: string; role?: string }) => api.get('/staff-attendance/export', { params, responseType: 'blob' }), getSettings: () => api.get('/staff-attendance/settings'), updateSettings: (data: { school_latitude?: number | null; school_longitude?: number | null; radius_meters?: number; check_in_start?: string; check_in_end?: string }) => api.post('/staff-attendance/settings', data) };`.

Modify src/components/layouts/DashboardLayout.tsx navigation array: add `{ name: 'Absen Masuk', href: '/absen-masuk', icon: ClipboardCheck, roles: ['guru', 'staff'] }` immediately after the 'Sesi Absensi' item; add `{ name: 'Absen Masuk Pegawai', href: '/admin/absen-masuk', icon: ClipboardCheck, roles: ['admin'] }` immediately after 'Kelola Ujian' in the admin block. ClipboardCheck is already imported from lucide-react — do NOT add a duplicate import.

Create src/app/absen-masuk/page.tsx ('use client', default export wrapped in <DashboardLayout>). Use the GPS helper: `const getLocation = (): Promise<{lat:number,lng:number}|null> => new Promise(resolve => { if(!navigator.geolocation){resolve(null);return;} const timer=setTimeout(()=>resolve(null),8000); navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(pos=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve({lat:pos.coords.latitude,lng:pos.coords.longitude});},()=>{clearTimeout(timer);resolve(null);}); });`. On mount call staffAttendanceAPI.todayStatus(); if has_checked_in show a status card (jam masuk from checked_in_at, metode from location_method, green badge); else show a large teal/cyan 'Absen Masuk Sekarang' button. On tap: setLoading, call getLocation() (8s timeout, null on failure/denial), get device_id from localStorage ('device_id') generating it if absent with btoa([navigator.userAgent,navigator.language,screen.width+'x'+screen.height,new Date().getTimezoneOffset()].join('|')).slice(0,32) and localStorage.setItem, call staffAttendanceAPI.checkIn({latitude:loc?.lat,longitude:loc?.lng,device_id}) and update state from response (success/error message). Below, show a 7-day mini history table (Tanggal, Jam Masuk, Metode, Status) from staffAttendanceAPI.myHistory(). Reuse Card/CardHeader/Button from '@/components/ui'. Handle loading and error states.

Create src/app/admin/absen-masuk/page.tsx ('use client', <DashboardLayout>). Heading 'Absen Masuk Pegawai'; a 'Pengaturan' link to '/admin/absen-masuk/settings'; an 'Export CSV' button. Filters: a date picker (default today) and a role select (Semua/Guru/Staff). Load via staffAttendanceAPI.adminIndex({date,role}) (re-fetch on filter change). Three summary cards: Total Pegawai, Sudah Absen, Belum Absen. Table columns: No, Nama, NIP, Jabatan, Role, Jam Masuk, Metode Lokasi, Status (badge); rows where checked_in_at is null highlighted light gray. Export CSV: call staffAttendanceAPI.adminExportCsv({date,role}) (responseType blob), build a blob URL with the response.data and Content-Type text/csv, trigger an <a download> click, then revoke. Handle loading + error states.

Create src/app/admin/absen-masuk/settings/page.tsx ('use client', <DashboardLayout>). Form fields: Latitude Sekolah (number input), Longitude Sekolah (number input), Radius in meters (number, min 50 max 5000), Jam Mulai (<input type='time'>), Jam Akhir (<input type='time'>). On mount load staffAttendanceAPI.getSettings() and populate the form. Save via staffAttendanceAPI.updateSettings({...}) on submit, show success/error feedback. Include an info block explaining how to find coordinates via Google Maps (right-click a point -> the coordinates popover).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` from repo root compiles cleanly (all three new pages + modified api.ts and DashboardLayout.tsx type-check and build; no missing imports).
`npm run lint` from repo root passes for the new/modified frontend files.

The /absen-masuk page requests GPS with an 8s timeout and resolves null on failure/denial, never blocking the UI; device_id is read from or created in localStorage using the same pattern as scan-qr/page.tsx.
The admin rekap page filters by date and role and shows Total/Sudah Absen/Belum Absen summary; the Export CSV button downloads a CSV blob with the selected filters.
The admin settings page loads existing settings on mount and saves school coordinates/radius/check-in window via the settings endpoint.
verification: From repo root: `npm run build` (clean compile, no missing imports)
From repo root: `npm run lint` (no lint errors in new/modified files)
findings: FEAT-002 depends on FEAT-001: the endpoints called by staffAttendanceAPI (POST /staff-attendance/check-in, GET /staff-attendance/today, GET /staff-attendance/history, GET /staff-attendance, GET /staff-attendance/export, GET+POST /staff-attendance/settings) must exist and be registered in api.php. Build/lint verification does NOT require the backend to be running — it compiles against the api.ts signatures — so FEAT-002 can be verified immediately after FEAT-001.
